subject: AP cascade: splitting single PO across three legal entities (VAT mapping & cost centers)
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@medware-inc.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medware-inc.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0500
Subject: Single PO / split invoice request for PO#8873

Mina —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We have a single PO (PO#8873) that covers services across three countries (DE/UK/US) and our internal AP process requires either (a) three invoices issued to different legal entities so we can route payments directly, or (b) one consolidated invoice with a line-level split and VAT treatment indicated per line.

Details:
- Total PO value: EUR 198,500 (see attached PO PDF)
- Requested due date: 2026-12-15
- Our procurement team prefers separate invoices when possible, since our ERP needs entity-level VAT IDs.

Please confirm if Redwood can:
1) Issue three invoices pinned to the specific legal entities (we will provide VAT IDs and billing addresses) OR
2) Provide a single invoice with CSV mapping table we can ingest (field list: invoice_line_id, legal_entity_id, net_amount, vat_rate, cost_center_code).

We also need the accounting remittance instructions for each legal entity and whether Redwood will apply reverse-charge for DE/UK lines (we're VAT-registered).

Happy to hop on a short call if it helps — procurement@medware-inc.com is cc'd.

Best,
Sofia Martinez
Senior Procurement Manager
Medware Inc.

Attachment: medware_po_8873.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@medware-inc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Single PO / split invoice request for PO#8873

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the clear note and the PO. We can support both approaches but recommend issuing three entity-level invoices to keep VAT and remittance clean for your ERP. Below is what we need from you to proceed quickly, and Ive looped in Ben (Finance) and Lauren (Account Exec) to align on timing.

What we need from Medware to generate separate invoices:
- Legal entity names + billing addresses (for each invoice recipient)
- VAT IDs for DE and UK entities
- Desired split by line or percentage (if you send a CSV we can consume)
- Any PO/PO-line mapping if you want line-level routing

Proposal / next steps:
1) You send back a quick CSV using our template (attached: entity-split-template.csv). Fields: invoice_line_id, legal_entity_label, percent_split, cost_center_code, vat_flag.
2) Ben will create three draft invoices and share a mutual-action-plan (MAP) for sign-off (attachment: mutual-action-plan-v1.xlsx).
3) We will include explicit line-level VAT treatment notes and the remit_to_legal_entity_id in the invoice metadata so your ERP can automate reconciliations.

If you prefer a single consolidated invoice with an attached CSV, we can do that too — let us know.

Ill hold a 30 minute slot today at 4pm ET if you want to review the mapping live — Lauren, can you confirm availability and own the call invite?

Thanks,

— Mina Haddad
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Single PO / split invoice request for PO#8873

Sofia / team —

I pulled a quick draft workflow for how Finance will handle this so everyone has a clear checklist. Key points below; I attached a sample CSV export (entity_mapping_snapshot.csv) showing the fields our billing engine requires.

Finance handling notes (recommended):
- We will issue three invoices, one per Redwood legal entity: Redwood EU GmbH (DE), Redwood UK Ltd (UK), Redwood US Inc (US).
- Each invoice will include: PO#, our invoice_number, invoice_line_id mapping (line IDs from your PO or aggregated lines), net_amount, vat_amount (if applicable), and a custom field remit_to_legal_entity_id that your ERP can map.
- VAT treatment: For DE & UK lines we will mark VAT as reverse-charge where your VAT ID indicates intra-EU/UK B2B reverse charge. If Medware confirms VAT IDs, we will compute vat_amount = 0 and include the reverse-charge note on the invoice.
- Cost centers: Please pass cost_center_code per line. If absent, we will default to the account-level cost center you previously provided (Medware: ENT-OPS-001).
- Payment remittance: We will provide three remittance instruction blocks (bank account, SWIFT, IBAN where relevant).

Required fields in the CSV (as in attached):
invoice_line_id, legal_entity_label, legal_entity_vat_id, net_amount, percent_split, cost_center_code, requested_invoice_date

Timeline: once we receive the completed CSV and the VAT IDs, Finance will:
- Produce draft invoices within 2 business days
- Share draft invoices + MAP for Medware sign-off within 48 hours after draft
- Final invoices issued upon sign-off

Attachments included: entity_mapping_snapshot.csv (sample) and a one-page MAP in the shared Drive (link below).

Lauren — if you can own the sign-off loop with Sofia, we can proceed on receiving the CSV.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
